title: Concept: Hex dependency declared without a requirement
description: mix.exs declares a `mix.exs` dependency with no version requirement, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Mix resolves the newest release on every fetch, so a package published after review installs with no change to the file.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through mix.exs (hex).
risk: Mix resolves the newest release on every fetch, so a package published after review installs with no change to the file.
